column7: SECTION-RETRACTION: the removed gmeow:FormalLanguage class is recovered as the lang:SignSystemKind individual lang:formalLanguageKind — the natural/formal/programming distinction moves from a subclass ladder to kind individuals, and a sign system points at this kind through lang:signSystemKind. relatedMatch, not equivalent: a class is retracted onto a kind INDIVIDUAL, a cross-category move.

DEEPEN / EMBEDDING (isomorphism rung): gmeow:Language is grafted as a specialization of lang:SignSystem (rdfs:subClassOf lang:SignSystem in module.ttl), embedding the language kind into the sign-system reference layer with no loss — a language IS a sign system, distinguished by lang:SignSystemKind rather than a local class ladder. broadMatch: lang:SignSystem is the broader grounding class.

SECTION-RETRACTION: the removed gmeow:ProgrammingLanguage class is recovered as the lang:SignSystemKind individual lang:programmingLanguageKind, which REFINES lang:formalLanguageKind through skos:broader so the ProgrammingLanguage subClassOf FormalLanguage subsumption survives as a kind-individual broader edge. relatedMatch, not equivalent: class retracted onto a kind individual.

LENS (leg 2 of 2): the removed gmeow:WritingSystem splits into lang:Script and lang:Orthography. This leg maps the writing-convention facet — how a sign system is bound to a script — onto lang:Orthography. relatedMatch: a lossy split, one term projected onto the second of two grounding terms.

LENS (leg 1 of 2): the removed gmeow:WritingSystem splits into lang:Script (the character repertoire) and lang:Orthography (the sign-system-to-script convention). This leg maps the repertoire facet — a WritingSystem's script identity — onto lang:Script. relatedMatch: a lossy split, one term projected onto the first of two grounding terms.

ISOMORPHISM (identity unification): the removed seed individual gmeow:langEnglish is unified with the lang: sign system lang:english — the same English language under one identity. The x-gmeow-english private-use tag now rides lang:carrierTag on the carrier variety lang:gmeowEnglish, and the lexvo/Wikidata alignments move onto lang:english.

ISOMORPHISM (identity unification): the removed seed individual gmeow:langFrench is unified with the lang: sign system lang:french. The x-gmeow-french private-use tag now rides lang:carrierTag on the carrier variety lang:gmeowFrench, and the lexvo/Wikidata alignments move onto lang:french.

ISOMORPHISM (identity unification): the removed seed individual gmeow:langMandarin is unified with the lang: sign system lang:mandarin. The x-gmeow-mandarin private-use tag now rides lang:carrierTag on the carrier variety lang:gmeowMandarin, and the lexvo/Wikidata alignments move onto lang:mandarin.

SECTION-RETRACTION: the removed gmeow:languageTag (the internal x-gmeow-* private-use tag on every language individual) is retracted onto lang:carrierTag, which survives ONLY on the three framework-authoring carrier varieties (lang:gmeowEnglish/gmeowFrench/gmeowMandarin) that tag GMEOW's own source literals. relatedMatch: the property survives for the carriers, not as a per-language attribute.

GRAFT (retention + regrounding): gmeow:TransliterationScheme is RETAINED as the named romanization/transcription value vocabulary (Hepburn, Pinyin, ISO 233, …). The lang: layer regrounds transliteration as a rendering-layer map: a lang:TransliterationMap grafts a retained gmeow:TransliterationScheme individual through lang:transliterationScheme and names its lang:transliterationSourceOrthography and lang:transliterationTargetOrthography over the language's lang:Script orthographies. The core-slice property gmeow:transliterationScheme (Appellation → scheme) and the grounding property lang:transliterationScheme (TransliterationMap → scheme) name the SAME scheme vocabulary from the two sides of the graft. relatedMatch: the scheme individual is shared; the map-side property is the lang: regrounding, not the core property. See slices/core/language/examples/multilingual-document.ttl for a worked ex:mapHepburn TransliterationMap whose crossing carries a logic:SoundUnderApproximation preservation judgment.
